summary: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you think and talk your way through anything and you go after what you want and don't back down - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: Whether you show it or not, a fast, restless mind and a strong will and deep reserves of energy flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally - you think and talk your way through anything and you go after what you want and don't back down - which is exactly why it's easy to coast on. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
gift: At your best: you think and talk your way through anything, and you go after what you want and don't back down.
shadow: The trap: you overthink it, or talk when you should feel, or your temper gets ahead of you, or you sit on it, then lash out at whoever is closest.
integration: Let thinking and speech and drive and anger cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Fast, cutting thinking; the task is channeling the edge productively.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think and you go after what you want work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: Let the reflex make the decision
